residuals.statement: This graph is kind-level (artifact kinds and binding vocabularies), not instance-level; per-project instance fixtures belong to FRF-2 RED fixtures and FRF-10 regenerated corpora.

Reconciliation against the forward graph and the installed graph is coordinator-owned (FRF-WP02 reconciliation step) and must classify every non-empty difference; this artifact is frozen before that comparison by construction.

Ledger D-10's question (whether the installed baseline folds dispositions/evidence bindings into digests where the plan enumerates them as named sections) cannot be resolved from the handoff side alone; edges edge/0081 and edge/0082 require those sections to be addressable frozen content, so the coordinator must reconcile the fold during FRF-7.

Two two-edge citation cycles are intentional: material/solution-contract vs material/development-case (edge/0015 hands off byte-for-byte; edge/0017 carries the contract as a required value) and material/uc-scenario vs material/uc-terminal-branch (edge/0064 declares branches; edge/0094 resolves a branch to its owning scenario); reconciliation should not read either as an accidental loop.

values.scenario_required: must be covered by at least one UC scenario

nodeKinds.composition-obligation: integration/composition obligation derived from SRS realization
nodeKinds.construction-obligation: typed infrastructure/construction obligation derived from SRS surfaces
nodeKinds.development-plan: Development task plan composed of WorkItems
nodeKinds.evidence-record: accepted evidence binding of a declared kind
nodeKinds.gate-decision-record: kernel GateDecision evidence of a failed gate
nodeKinds.scenario-branch: main/alternate/error flow branch ending in a terminal result
nodeKinds.settlement-trace-set: accepted trace/member-binding set frozen in the baseline
nodeKinds.source-claim: Discovery source claim or source constraint
nodeKinds.terminal-claim: assertion made by reaching a terminal node

planInvalidOmissions.constraint: a Development plan covering every AC but omitting any of these is invalid

traceGrammarRules.fr-derived-from-prd-and-uc-branches-when: FR --derived_from--> PRD and one or more UC branches when scenario-derived
traceGrammarRules.nfr-derived-from-prd-optionally-uc-when-: NFR --derived_from--> PRD and optionally UC when scenario-local
traceGrammarRules.prd-derived-from-brief-and-source-claims: PRD --derived_from--> brief and exact Discovery source claims
traceGrammarRules.rule-derived-from-prd-optionally-uc-when: RULE --derived_from--> PRD and optionally UC when scenario-local
traceGrammarRules.scenario-facing-ac-derived-from-uc-and-t: scenario-facing AC --derived_from--> UC and terminal scenario branch
traceGrammarRules.uc-derived-from-prd-intent-members: UC --derived_from--> PRD and exact PRD intent members

workItemObligationKinds.constraint: a WorkItem must bind one or more of these five kinds

values.infrastructure-obligation: binds typed SRS construction obligations not one-to-one with AC
values.integration-or-composition-obligation: binds composition owners, runtime edges, external interfaces
values.scenario-realization-obligation: binds SRS scenario-realization entries (entrypoint, terminal result, evidence)
